svg.aria-label: botflow-mcp — Chatbot funnels, built by talking to a model. Connect a bot, describe a flow in plain steps, and the server runs the conversation: questions, answers, button branches, tags and broadcasts to tagged segments. It speaks MCP; Telegram is reached by long polling.
